questions.question: In a ΔABC, the median BE intersects AC at E. If BG = 12 cm, where G is the centroid, then BE is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

BG = 12 cm

**Concept used:**

The centroid divides each median into two parts, which are always in the ratio 2 :1.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31f469918021ccb968e2d1224724f6f572b3ae82ea4135d077f004fc262df89e.png] 

Accoring to the concept,

BG : GE = 2 : 1

So, GE = 6 cm

Now,

BE = BG + GE

⇒ 12 + 6

⇒ 18 cm

**∴ BE is equal to 18 cm.**

questions.question: The tax on the salary of C is {{1} over 4} of the salary and savings are {{1} over 3} of the salary. The ratio of the expenditures to the savings is ______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The tax on the salary of C is {{1} over 4} of the salary and savings are {{1} over 3} of the salary.

**Calculation:**

Let the salary of C be 12a

So,

tax = 12a × {{1} over 4}

⇒ 3a

savings = 12a × {{1} over 3}

⇒ 4a

So, expenditure = 12a - 3a - 4a

⇒ 5a

Ratio of expenditure : saving = 5a : 4a

⇒ 5 : 4

**∴ The required answer is 5 : 4.**

questions.question: A dishonest trader says to customers that he sells his goods at a cost price, but he uses a false weight and gains 12.5% as profit. How many grams does he use to weigh 1 kg?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit = 12.5% = 1/8.

This means for every 8 parts of actual weight given (cost base), the dealer gains 1 part.

Total Claimed Weight = 8 parts (Base) + 1 part (Profit) = 9 parts.

Since 9 parts = 1000 g, the False Weight (8 parts) = (1000 ÷ 9) × 8.

False Weight = 8000 ÷ 9 ≈ 888.8 g.

**∴ The correct answer is 888.8 g.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit percentage = 12.5%

Claimed true weight = 1 kg = 1000 g

**Formula Used:**

Profit % = [(True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30cd207b6dde45186892ae9c6eb6fd0a9f6623a7ce0a6f642ef9fced50c653e0.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ 12.5 = [(1000 − False Weight) ÷ False Weight] × 100

⇒ 12.5 ÷ 100 = (1000 − False Weight) ÷ False Weight

⇒ 1 ÷ 8 = (1000 − False Weight) ÷ False Weight

⇒ False Weight = 8 × (1000 − False Weight)

⇒ False Weight = 8000 − 8 × False Weight

⇒ 9 × False Weight = 8000

⇒ False Weight = 8000 ÷ 9

⇒ False Weight ≈ 888.8 g

**∴ The correct answer is 888.8 g.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Selling at Cost Price

When a dealer claims to sell at the cost price but uses a false weight, the profit is generated entirely from the weight difference. Profit % = [(True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight] × 100.

Dishonest Dealer Selling at a Markup

If the dealer also marks up the price by x% along with using a false weight, the effective profit multiplier becomes: True SP ÷ True CP = [(100 + x) ÷ 100] × [True Weight ÷ False Weight].

Using Ratio Method for Dishonest Dealer

When a dealer cheats on both weight and price, write the ratios of CP to SP for both cases. Multiply the ratios to get the final equivalent CP and SP, which gives the overall profit or loss percentage directly.

questions.question: Find the largest number of 3 digits divisible by 4 and 7.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

LCM of 4, 7 is 28

The greatest number of 3 digits = 999

⇒ 999 ÷ 28

⇒ Reminder = 19

**∴ The greatest number of 3 digits is 980.**

questions.question: A and B working separately can complete a piece of work in 10 and 16 days, respectively. If they work for a day alternately, with A beginning the work, in how many day(s) will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B working separately can complete a piece of work in 10 and 16 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = efficiency of the worker × time taken by them

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be 80 units

So, the efficiency of A and B = 8 units/day, 5 units/day

Effective efficiency of the two = 13 units/day

According to the question,

They work on alternative days

So, in 2 days work completed = 13 units

In 12 days work completed = 78 units

Now,

The remaining 2 units will be completed by A in 2/8 days or 1/4 days

So, total time = 12 + 1/4 days

⇒ 12{{1} over 4} days

**∴ The work is completed in 12{{1} over 4} days.**

questions.question: A sum becomes Rs. 15,500 in 7 years on simple interest at the rate of 30 percent per annum. What is the total interest for the 7 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum becomes Rs. 15500

Rate of interest (r) = 30% per annum

Time period (t) = 7 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (Prt/100)

Where,

P = principal amount

r = rate of interest

t = time period

**Calculation:**

If the sum becomes Rs. 16000 Means,

[P + (S.I)] = sum

⇒ [P + (Prt /100)] = sum

⇒ [P + (P × 30 × 7)/ 100] = 15500

⇒ [P + (P × 210/100)] = 15500

⇒ [P + (21P/10)] = 15500

⇒ [31P/10] = 15500

⇒ P = 15500 × (10/31)

⇒ P = 5000

So, S.I = 15500 - 5000

⇒ Rs. 10500

**∴ The total interest for the 7 years is Rs. 10500.**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 0, then what is the value of {{x²} over (yz)} + {{y²} over (xz)} + {{z²} over (xy)}?
questions.solution:

x + y + z = 0

**Concept used:**

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x2 + y2 + z2​-xy-yz-zx)

If x + y + z = 0, then

x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz = 0

So, x3 + y3 + z3 = 3xyz

**Calculation:**

{{x²} over (yz)} + {{y²} over (xz)} + {{z²} over (xy)}

⇒ {{x³ + y³ + z³} over (xyz)}

⇒ {{3xyz} over xyz}

⇒ 3

**∴ The required answer is 3.**

questions.question: The area of a sector of a circle is 308 cm², with the central angle measuring 45°. The radius of the circle is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The area of a sector of a circle is 308 cm2

The angle of the sector is 45°

Concept used:

Area of a sector = πr2 × θ/360°

θ = angle of the sector

r = radius

Calculation:

According to the question,

(45^o)/(360^o) × π r² = 308

⇒ πr2 = 308 × 8

⇒ 22/7 × r2 = 2464

⇒ r2 = 784

⇒ r = 28cm

So, radius = 28 cm

∴ The radius of the circle is 28 cm.

questions.question: The cost of apples is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net pecentage decrease?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost of apples is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%.

**Calculation:**

Let the price of apples be Rs. 100

After increase it is 100 × 120%

⇒ Rs. 120

After decrease it is 120 × 80%

⇒ Rs. 96

So, decrease = 100 - 96

⇒ Rs. 4

% of decrease = (4/100) × 100

⇒ 4%

**∴ The net percentage decrease is 4%.**
